name: Snare-Oh
abilities: Generates and controls ~30 ft of bandage tendrils (grapple, lift, restrain)
Bandages strong enough to hold Fourmungousaur and sharp enough to cut vines
Body reshaping / splitting apart to dodge
Unravels to fly and slip through tight spaces
Corrodium immunity; can shield Corrodium inside his body
weaknesses: Can be tangled in his own bandages
Can be controlled by Vladat Corrupturas
Can be scared by Toepick's species
summary: Ben's mummy: a pharaoh-crowned Thep Khufan whose body is living bandage that grapples, restrains, unravels and reforms.
traits: DNA sampled from the Mummy in Under Wraps
Ben 10,000's version wears the Mummy's garment pattern
notableFeats: Fought the Werewolf on his first use (The Return)
Ben 10,000 used him to fetch Ken from a vent while fighting Kevin 11,000 (Ken 10)
Grappled onto an Incursean space fighter (The Frogs of War: Part 1)
Herded a Pyroxovore stampede back to its pens (Return to Forever)
Trapped Psyphon and the Squid Monsters (Bengeance is Mine)
Saved Rook and Kai from a fall and fought a Jungle Guardian (The Secret of Dos Santos)

appearances.designNotes: Green-glowing eyes and gaps between bandages, black-and-gold pharaoh headdress, black bracers and greaves, original Omnitrix on the left shoulder. Ben 10,000's version wears the Mummy's own garment pattern (no chin beard).

Greyish-brown ragged layered bandages, shorter back tendrils, black headdress with green gaps and gold rim, gold crown spikes round the eyes, wrapped lower face with a gold beard-spine, striped shoulder collar with 'eye' pads, gold-trimmed bracers/greaves, Omnitrix on a green/white belt. 11- and 16-year-old share the design.

scoring.rationale: Long-reach bandage grapples, splitting to dodge and reforming from confetti make him hard to put down, and he survives space and water. Modest raw offense; heat and self-tangling are exploitable.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
Also used by Benzarro (And Then There Were None) - not counted.
